verdict.rationale: Linking errors to issue trackers is a fair axis for an error-tracking product, but nothing in the evidence documents linking errors to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear, let alone two-way status sync with resolve and reopen. The GitLab integration only lets GitLab display GlitchTip errors through its Sentry-compatible data source, and alert webhooks and the general Sentry API compatibility claim are adjacent features. Neither delivers ticket linking or status sync.
